evidence.claim: Signal (a): after dispatching substitution payloads through every sink, the canary marker file is absent. The detector control splice-eval of $(touch PATH) and backticks creates the same marker, so absence is not a dead detector.

Signal (b): every sink records the original parameter bytes. 300 injection payloads (241 with $(, backtick, or % tokens) round-trip through argv, env, file, and stdin. A cmd.exe %PATH% expander changes the value; the pipeline does not.

implementation.mechanism: Parameters are passed as argv elements, environment values, file bytes, or stdin. dispatch never interpolates a parameter into a shell script string and refuses subprocess shell mode. tools/lib/codex-invocation.mjs exists and keeps the prompt on stdin rather than argv; named probes exercise tools/shell/param_pipeline.py as the live substitution gate.

negative_controls.description: bash -c interpolating $(touch CANARY) must create the marker.
bash -c interpolating backtick-touch must create the marker.
cmd.exe-model %PATH% expansion must change the value; the pipeline must record %PATH% literally.

notes: G-1 TST-0193: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. SUCCESS:TST-0193
question_or_target: Can a workflow parameter containing $(...), backticks or %VAR% cause command substitution anywhere in the pipeline? PASS requires zero substitution across every parameter sink, proven by a canary that would create a marker file if evaluated.

residual_unknowns.claim: pwsh7 and Git Bash were not re-run on this Linux worktree. %VAR% expansion is proven with a cmd.exe-model expander, not live cmd.exe.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run probe1 and probe2 under pwsh7 and Git Bash on Windows; confirm the canary still appears only on splice-eval.

residual_unknowns.claim: tools/lib/codex-invocation.mjs is in the tree. It writes the prompt to a file and streams it on stdin; argv ends with '-'. A Windows .cmd shim may set shell:true. Named probes do not spawn that module; they gate tools/shell/param_pipeline.py.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Point named probes at createCodexExecPlan spawn and confirm $(...) / backticks / %VAR% still stay literal.

reviewer.notes: Catalog asks an independent reviewer to re-run on a second Windows shell (pwsh7 and Git Bash). This G-1 delivery uses probe2 as the independent mechanical re-run on Linux bash. pwsh=absent; git-bash=absent. A human Windows-shell pass is not claimed.

title: Workflow parameters are never re-parsed by a shell
